statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. Checked with `go list -deps` on both binaries in the CI build (images run 37738632616, both arches): node-agent v0.3.258 (./cmd) and ./cmd/sbom-scanner each link github.com/docker/docker/client, api, the api/types packages and pkg/homedir, and from github.com/moby/moby only pkg/stringid (a random ID helper); no daemon, plugin manager, api/server or pkg/authorization package of either module path. The build fails if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the new moby module path, so the +incompatible modules cannot be floated to it.

CVE-2026-34040 is an authorization bypass in the Moby daemon's AuthZ plugin handling of API requests. Checked with `go list -deps` on both binaries in the CI build (images run 37738632616, both arches): node-agent v0.3.258 (./cmd) and ./cmd/sbom-scanner each link github.com/docker/docker/client, api, the api/types packages and pkg/homedir, and from github.com/moby/moby only pkg/stringid (a random ID helper); no daemon, plugin manager, api/server or pkg/authorization package of either module path. The build fails if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the new moby module path, so the +incompatible modules cannot be floated to it.

Measured 2026-11-10 on a local build of kubescape-node-agent 0.3.310. /usr/bin/node-agent is built on upstream's go.mod pins (replace containerd/v2 => v2.2.0, runtime-spec => v1.2.1, the combination upstream tests: with the v2.2.10 + runtime-spec 1.3 override the binary recorded no container profile in the chart gate, charts run 42792511808). `govulncheck -mode=binary /usr/bin/node-agent` lists every containerd/v2 v2.2.0 advisory only under modules the binary requires and reports 0 vulnerabilities in packages it imports: none of the affected containerd/v2 packages (CRI plugin, checkpoint restore, image unpack, user resolution) is compiled into node-agent. /usr/bin/sbom-scanner, the binary that does use containerd/v2 (through syft), is built on v2.2.10, which carries the fixes, so this statement matches only the v2.2.0 module in node-agent.
